title: Device frame
description: Data contract of one reusable device frame (PRD §5.5, §6.1). Static data only: the frame's drawing lives in renderer/remotion/media/frames, keyed by id. Positions are percentages of the frame box, so no pixels or CSS appear here.

aspect.description: The frame's own shape, width:height. The frame box is the largest of this shape inside the canvas safe area.

content.description: The safe content box: where footage is drawn, as percentages of the frame box. The box must lie inside the frame (checked by the loader).

tokens.description: Theme token paths the frame draws with, for example colors.surface. Each must exist in every theme (checked by the renderer's parity test).
